assertions.description: Previously certified artifacts remain consumer-loadable without identity drift.
assertions.assertionSemantics: Resolve the governed package for the requested county and compare its immutable identity with packageAuthority.
assertions.expectedResult: Resolve the governed package for the requested county and compare its immutable identity with packageAuthority.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected read-only package resolution capture plus identity comparison.

assertions.description: Existing operational-county discovery and selection remain correct.
assertions.assertionSemantics: A governed county query discovers and selects only the requested operational county.
assertions.expectedResult: A governed county query discovers and selects only the requested operational county.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected consumer journey capture of county discovery and selection.

assertions.description: County-edge behavior does not spill results into an adjacent county.
assertions.scope: governed edge fixture for each exact Wave 0 FIPS
assertions.assertionSemantics: Each edge fixture retains its governed county identity and returns no unexplained adjacent-county result.
assertions.expectedResult: Each edge fixture retains its governed county identity and returns no unexplained adjacent-county result.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected consumer edge-journey capture compared with approved fixtures.

assertions.description: Representative community, destination, crossing, and awareness results remain understandable and stable.
assertions.scope: approved representative fixtures spanning exact Wave 0 FIPS
assertions.assertionSemantics: Every approved fixture loads the expected county-scoped result with no unexplained empty or ambiguous result.
assertions.expectedResult: Every approved fixture loads the expected county-scoped result with no unexplained empty or ambiguous result.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected consumer-visible journey capture and exact expected-result comparison.

assertions.description: Empty and ambiguous inputs retain governed fallback behavior.
assertions.scope: approved empty and ambiguous fixtures spanning exact Wave 0 FIPS
assertions.assertionSemantics: Each fixture produces its predeclared truthful empty/ambiguity outcome without cross-county substitution.
assertions.expectedResult: Each fixture produces its predeclared truthful empty/ambiguity outcome without cross-county substitution.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected consumer-visible fallback capture and exact expected-result comparison.

assertions.description: Route/watch awareness remains county-correct for governed fixtures.
assertions.scope: approved route/watch fixtures spanning exact Wave 0 FIPS
assertions.assertionSemantics: Each fixture retains expected route context, awareness area, and county identity.
assertions.expectedResult: Each fixture retains expected route context, awareness area, and county identity.
assertions.evidenceMethod: Protected read-only route/watch journey capture and exact expected-result comparison.
